verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Tailscale ships an official CLI with a first-party reference page (docs/reference/tailscale-cli), which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a single probe pointer, though, with no detail on the CLI's commands or scripting behavior. missing for 10: detailed command coverage in the evidence, evidence of agent- or automation-friendly CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
